content_blocks.label: clause_1._DEFINITIONS
content_blocks.text: ‘Confidential Information’ means any information disclosed by the Disclosing Party, whether in written, oral, electronic, or other form, that is marked as confidential or that would reasonably be expected to be treated as confidential.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_OBLIGATIONS
content_blocks.text: The Receiving Party shall use the Confidential Information solely for the purposes set forth in the agreement and shall not disclose it to any third party without the prior written consent of the Disclosing Party.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._TERM
content_blocks.text: This NDA shall remain in effect until the expiration of all obligations of the parties under this NDA.

content_blocks.label: notary_note
content_blocks.text: Sworn before me this 11th day of November 2024.
